ai.headline: Search impressions badhkar 52 ho gaye, monitoring Cloudflare se block hui
ai.summary: Google Search Console par impressions 52 tak pahuche hain (avg position 30.75), lekin abhi clicks 0 hain. Cloudflare bot protection ne monitoring tools ko 403 block kiya hai jise dashboard me check karna hoga. AdSense ke liye abhi organic traffic build karna zaroori hai.
youDo: Cloudflare Dashboard (dash.cloudflare.com) me Security Events check karein aur dekhein ki monitoring ray IDs kyu block hui, bina global security hataye monitoring IP ko bypass/allowlist karein.
Normal browser me homemoneycalc.com aur /paycheck-calculator/ open karke verify karein ki site aam users ke liye live aur accessible hai.
Growth checklist se Ahrefs Webmaster Tools (ahrefs.com/webmaster-tools) setup karein taaki backlink tracking start ho sake.
Roadmap ke 3 naye calculators (No Tax on Overtime, No Tax on Tips, Overtime Pay) ki files review karein jo 2026-10-30 ke target ke liye drafted hain.
agentNext: Next crawl me Cloudflare status monitor karna ki automated checks wapas normal HTTP 200 de rahe hain ya nahi.
Search Console queries (jaise 'mortgage payoff calculator' aur 'how do i calculate...') ki ranking movement track karna.
Roadmap tools deploy hote hi internal links aur schema validation auto-run karna.
risks: Cloudflare 403 blocks agar galat configure ho gaye toh real search bot crawlers (Googlebot/Bingbot) bhi block ho sakte hain.
AdSense ke liye abhi apply karna policy rejection dega kyunki search clicks abhi 0 hain aur baseline organic traffic criteria meet nahi hua.
Tax tools me bina IRS/SSA official confirmation ke updates karne se user calculation galat ho sakti hai.
